changelog.body:
## 更新

- 新增「快捷入口熄屏保活」。从底角手势或电源键调出 Gemini 浮层并开始 Live 后，熄屏时允许 Google App 使用其自身的浮层任务移除分支继续通话。
- 新增「亮屏保活」及独立的时长设置。可选 1–20 分钟，默认 20 分钟。
- 两个新开关默认关闭。覆盖安装后重启，再开启需要的功能。

目标手机已复测快捷入口启动后锁屏仍能听到回答。真机系统日志显示同一 Live 服务持续到再次亮屏。兼容范围及测试边界见[项目说明](https://github.com/IamMapleZeng/GeminiVoiceCallKeepLive)。

## English

- Added opt-in screen-off continuity for Live sessions started from the Gemini floating shortcut.
- Added a separate screen-on deferral limit of 1–20 minutes, defaulting to 20 minutes.
- Both new switches default to off. Reboot after updating and enable the switches you need.

The user verified audible replies after locking a Live session started from the floating entry. Android events show that its Live service remained active through screen-off until the display next turned on. [Setup and compatibility](https://github.com/IamMapleZeng/GeminiVoiceCallKeepLive/blob/main/README.en.md)

- 可设置 1–20 分钟的无活动延后上限，默认 20 分钟。
- 添加麦克风启动器图标。
- 提供默认中文 README 和英文 README。

兼容范围和测试记录见[项目说明](https://github.com/IamMapleZeng/GeminiVoiceCallKeepLive)。

readme:
# Gemini Voice Call Keep Live

为已验证的 Google App 版本延后 Gemini Live 在熄屏期间的无活动超时。模块设置提供 **1–20 分钟**的延后上限，默认 **20 分钟**。用户主动结束、独立隐私超时和 Android 电源管理仍按各自流程运行。

当前行为 Hook 适用于小米 15 Ultra、HyperOS `OS4.0.3.0.XOACNXM`、Android 17 和 Google App `17.72.17.ve.arm64`（301831138）。在 LSPosed 2.2.1 中启用「系统框架」（`system`）和「Google」，重启后打开需要的保活开关。请同时开启 Gemini 的锁屏使用权限和 Live 通知。

0.1.0 已在上述设备通过手动锁屏 15 分钟对话和主动退出验证。自动息屏保活、黑屏蓝牙对话及移动数据切换仍待完整验证。0.1.3 新增「快捷入口熄屏保活」与可独立配置的「亮屏保活」，默认均关闭。已在目标手机实测从快捷浮层启动后，锁屏仍能收到回答。

[源码、中文安装和排障说明](https://github.com/IamMapleZeng/GeminiVoiceCallKeepLive)

## English

This module defers the Gemini Live inactivity timeout while the screen is off on the verified Google app and device builds. The limit is configurable from **1 to 20 minutes** and defaults to **20 minutes**. LSPosed needs the System Framework (`system`) and Google app scopes.

Manual lock for 15 minutes and normal call ending were verified in 0.1.0. Version 0.1.3 adds optional screen-on keep-live and floating-entry lock-screen continuity, which was verified on the target phone. End-to-end testing of automatic screen-off, Bluetooth with the screen off, and mobile-data handoff is still pending.

[English setup and troubleshooting](https://github.com/IamMapleZeng/GeminiVoiceCallKeepLive/blob/main/README.en.md)
